description.zh: 把五花八门的电子书整理成干净的书库：读取 epub、mobi、azw3、pdf 的书名作者，缺失时从文件名推断，统一命名为“作者 - 书名”并按作者归档，同书多格式放在一起，找出完全相同的重复文件，生成可记录已读和评分的书单。
description.en: Turns a messy ebook pile into a clean library: reads titles and authors from epub, mobi, azw3 and pdf (falling back to file names), renames to "Author - Title" grouped by author, keeps formats together, finds exact duplicates and builds a trackable reading list.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我电子书放在哪个文件夹
welcome_message.en: Tell me which folder holds your ebooks

prompt.zh: 盘点一下 ___ 里的电子书：多少本、什么格式、哪些识别不出作者。
prompt.en: Scan ebooks in ___: how many, which formats, which lack authors.

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 里的电子书按“作者 - 书名”整理到 ___，先给我看方案。
prompt.en: Organize ebooks in ___ as "Author - Title" into ___. Show the plan first.

prompt.zh: 找出书库里重复的电子书。
prompt.en: Find duplicate ebooks in my library.

prompt.zh: 给 ___ 生成一份书单 Excel，可以记录已读和评分。
prompt.en: Build an Excel reading list for ___ with read and rating columns.

prompt.zh: 我每天能读 ___ 分钟，从书单里帮我排一个 ___ 月的阅读计划。
prompt.en: I read ___ minutes a day. Plan ___ months of reading from my list.

prompt.zh: 我用 ___ 看书，书库里的格式该怎么选？txt 乱码怎么办？
prompt.en: I read on ___. Which formats should I keep? How do I fix garbled txt?

zh: 每月 1 日「10:00」盘点 inbound 中新增的电子书，生成整理方案
每月最后一天「20:00」统计本月读完的书，更新书单
每周日「21:00」提醒记录本周阅读进度和笔记
每季度第一天「10:00」检查书库中的重复文件
每年 1 月 2 日「10:00」生成上一年的阅读总结
每月 1 日「09:00」从待读书单中推荐本月 3 本书
en: On the 1st of each month at 10:00, scan new ebooks in inbound and plan their placement
On the last day of each month at 20:00, update the list with books finished this month
Every Sunday at 21:00, remind to log reading progress and notes
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, check the library for duplicates
On January 2 at 10:00, write last year's reading summary
On the 1st of each month at 09:00, suggest 3 books from the to-read list
